tasks.title: Explicit effect/capability system
tasks.objective: Model file/net/device/etc effects in IR and verifier
tasks.progress: Transitive policy analysis integrated into executeGraph before any host call (AC-029), including nested/unused nodes; capability/effect gates and declaration/grant validation tested. Effect IR profile and explicit nested sequencing implemented (AC-030); forged metadata and reversed dependencies rejected; pure compiler rejects hidden unused composite effects. AST fixed-point policy inference, pure/explicit budgets, extern checks, straight-line sequence lowering and CLI explicit grant file implemented (AC-031). Interface requirements survive IR. Pure sequences export; effectful compilation is explicitly unsupported. DONE for finite effect kernel; OS broker, full control/async and IO backends remain separate work.

tasks.title: Control-flow async and state semantics
tasks.objective: Specify & implement state, cancellation, futures, events and deterministic ordering where possible
tasks.progress: Finite reactor session (AC-032): typed state atoms, transactional FIFO handlers using existing IR, replay, bounded queue, abort propagation and late-write rejection. Textual counter runs through shared runtime. Structured control IR v2/lowering/runtime and pure standalone implemented (AC-033): eager text semantics, typed mutable scopes, if/while/for, short circuit, generic/local recursion, indexing, identical step/depth guards. Typed user throw/catch/finally profile implemented (AC-034): aliases/generics, terminal cancellation/budget guards, differential standalone, transaction rollback/replay and payload-free failure traces. Option/Result/match implemented (AC-035): explicit tagged values, nested exhaustive semantic patterns, aliases/generics, independent IR validation, exact budget/permission parity, algebraic catches/event inputs and standalone CLI export. Language async/Future implemented (AC-036): typed scoped hot tasks/await, cached outcomes, supervision and program join before event commit, root abort propagation, task ancestry/shared budgets and independent async standalone. Stream implemented (AC-037): owned snapshot sources/bounded FIFO channels, typed next/send/close and for-await, actual backpressure/copied values, computed localEffects, cancellation/terminal task wakeup, actor replay/rollback and independent standalone. ResourceHandle/using implemented (AC-038): owned typed cells, lexical LIFO cleanup outside execution ticks, runtime/independent standalone parity, trusted native lifecycle bindings with preflight, exact-once release attempts, late IO/cancellation/deadline failure diagnostics and event cleanup before commit. Full error/resource IDL and standalone state export remain pending.
